newsitem.title: USA: Berkshire Realty names Marshall CEO.
newsitem.headline: Berkshire Realty names Marshall CEO.

text.p: Berkshire Realty Co said Friday its board has named David Marshall as chief executive officer, replacing Laurence Gerber.
Gerber will continue to serve on the board as president and chief executive of the Berkshire Group, it said.
Marshall, 48, has been president of the Berkshire Realty since March 1, 1996.
The company said its board also approved the expansion of the number of directors from six to seven members and elected Marshall to serve as the additional member.
Berkshire Realty is an apartment-focused, equity real estate investment trust.
